theorem_contract.row_area_identity: ||rho/n-sigma/n||_1 equals normalized area of the symmetric difference of their left-justified Young diagrams.
theorem_contract.plancherel_limit_shape: VKLS normalized-area convergence implies that any fixed number of labels with Plancherel marginals are mutually o(1) in L1.
theorem_contract.diagonal_compatibility_witness: omega_ABC=sum_i r_i |iii><iii| has spectrum r on A,B,C,AB,BC,ABC.
theorem_contract.physical_transfer: The physical 6j trace-mass law gives exact Plancherel marginals for alpha,beta,gamma,mu,nu,lambda; dependence is harmless for a fixed six-label union bound.
theorem_contract.conclusion: The L1 distance D_n from a physical six-spectrum tuple to the tripartite quantum-marginal compatibility set tends to zero in probability.
theorem_contract.scope: No rate for D_n, recoupling norm lower bound, growing-row converse, or growing-size generalized 3nj compatibility theorem is claimed.

asymptotic_proof.external_limit_shape_input: Plancherel Young diagrams converge in normalized area to the VKLS shape.

literature_links.title: Asymptotics of the Plancherel measure of the symmetric group and the limiting form of Young tableaux
Recoupling coefficients and quantum entropies
literature_links.use: Tripartite marginal interpretation and L1 incompatibility distance in the recoupling suppression theorem.

proof_obligations.resolution: It converges to zero under physical trace mass by VKLS and the diagonal-state compatibility witness.
A rate is needed to decide whether n D_n^2 can still diverge.
The published polynomial lower branch assumes bounded local dimensions.
A growing network has more than a fixed six labels and may not inherit the same union-bound conclusion.

adversarial_audit.objection: Six correlated labels cannot share a limit-shape conclusion.
adversarial_audit.resolution: Each marginal is Plancherel and there are only six events, so a union bound needs no independence.

adversarial_audit.objection: Six nearly equal spectra need not be quantum-marginal compatible.
adversarial_audit.resolution: They are near the explicit compatible diagonal tuple (r,r,r,r,r,r).

adversarial_audit.objection: D_n=o(1) rules out every exponential or stretched-exponential suppression.
adversarial_audit.resolution: False. A shrinking D_n can still satisfy n D_n^2 -> infinity.

adversarial_audit.objection: Near compatibility proves a large physical recoupling norm.
adversarial_audit.resolution: The converse is fixed-dimensional and no dimension-uniform lower bound is available.

claim_gate.reason: Typical physical spectra are asymptotically near compatible, but neither the shrinking-gap rate nor the true growing-row norm is controlled.

summary: Proved that physical Plancherel 6j spectra approach the tripartite quantum-marginal compatibility set, closing constant-gap suppression.
falsifiers_triggered: Typical physical Plancherel spectra cannot remain a constant L1 distance outside compatibility.
Near compatibility is not a growing-row lower bound on recoupling coefficients.
A shrinking incompatibility gap may still create weaker suppression and requires a rate theorem.
